title: Step 1-1 — Dense 1B Data-Loader Study
setup: Dense 1B; exact repeated 1B-token document pool; sequence length 4096; default OLMo sequence reshuffling compared with dynamic document repacking and a fixed epoch-1 sequence/batch permutation. DR preserves the exact document multiset and begins at E2 from an exact LR/WD-matched Original E1 checkpoint. New BS64/128/256 trajectories use one 8-GPU node with rank microbatch eight and gradient accumulation 1/2/4; established BS512/1024 work uses four 8-GPU nodes.
selection: Frontier decisions use held-out DCLM validation CE, not noisy train CE. BS64 LR1e-3 runs WD0.3 and WD1.0 independently to first strict validation non-improvement. BS128 compares WD0.3 with WD1.0 and BS256 compares WD0.333 with WD1.0 at every completed frontier before any next-frontier submission: when WD1.0 wins, only WD1.0 continues; when WD1.0 loses, both trajectories may continue if each passes its own strict-improvement gate; a tie is held for review. At E8, WD1.0 lost both resolved competitions, so both WDs are eligible at E12. BS64 WD1.0, BS128 WD0.3, and BS256 WD1.0 E12 are running after manifest, preflight, exact checkpoint-load, trainer/optimizer-state, and first-step guards passed. The corrected BS128 WD1.0 E12 retry 01M02AH0APWS8GS78EWM0YG8J1 was submitted from exact canonical E8 step13732 and remains pending. Together with six unrelated pending flex2 jobs, it keeps the global queue gate closed, so the authorized BS256 WD0.333 E12 corrected retry remains planned. BS64 WD0.3 E24 remains its last validated frontier at CE2.97093 because E28 failed during endpoint checkpoint saving without validation. The formerly staged BS256 LR2e-3/WD0.333 coordinate is held unless explicitly reactivated. BS1024 DR and BS512 DR remain saturated in report history. Endpoint reporting remains validation-first and downstream evaluation is disabled.

selectionPolicy.learningRate: Active coordinates use LR1e-3 for BS64/128/256. The earlier BS256 LR2e-3/WD0.333 plan is held unless explicitly reactivated; LR above 2e-3 remains prohibited.
selectionPolicy.dynamicRepackingDirection: Run BS64 at WD0.3 and WD1.0 independently. For BS128 (WD0.3 versus WD1.0) and BS256 (WD0.333 versus WD1.0), resolve both WDs at the current frontier before submitting either next frontier. If WD1.0 strictly wins, continue only WD1.0; if WD1.0 loses, both may continue subject to their own strict-improvement gates; hold ties for review.
selectionPolicy.workspaceQueue: Submit a new experiment only when the ai2/flex2 workspace has zero other pending jobs. Eligible study frontiers remain planned/held while any pending flex2 job exists; running jobs do not trigger this queue gate.
conditionalQueue: BS256 DR LR2e-3/WD0.333 held unless explicitly reactivated
BS32 DR LR5e-4/WD0.3 only after consistent DR improvements
selectionPolicy.fixedOrderDirection: At E2 begin at WD0.333 and expand upward if needed, targeting Fixed > ordinary > DR; from the selected E2 coordinate onward test only equal or higher WD.
selectionPolicy.endpointReporting: Extract train CE and DCLM validation CE first. Do not wait for, ingest, validate, or display downstream task accuracy, BPB, or avg8 metrics; future submissions disable downstream evaluation on finish.
